<DOCSTRING>
Binds the game loop, alternating input between two players and checking for a winner.

This function does not accept any arguments and internally manages the game loop. It alternates between getting input from playerOne and playerTwo, checking for a winner after each round, and continues until a winner is found or the maximum number of rounds is reached.

Returns:
    void: Prints the winner or a draw after the game loop completes.
</DOCSTRING>
